script_text: Capricorn, this week is not a slow burn; it is Saturn handing you a signed contract with consequences. Monday into Wednesday, Venus in your 5th House trines your ruler Saturn in the 3rd, making romance, creative deals, and messages feel stable; Tuesday is best for a confession or proposal, while Monday’s Sun square Neptune in the 6th can blur workplace details. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 6th House, shifting desire into daily routines, health choices, and client chemistry. The mid-week turning point is Mercury in Gemini sextiling Saturn in Pisces, sharpening your voice and helping you negotiate money with precision. Late week, Mars in Taurus holds a 5th-House sextile to Pluto in Aquarius, 2nd House, so passion and income can merge through a side project or private investment. Thursday and Friday are strongest for career visibility, but Saturday’s Moon in Scorpio opposing your 10th-House Sun can trigger ego friction. Sunday favors rest and budgeting. Worst day is Monday because the 6th-House Sun-Neptune square invites missed emails or medical oversights. As an Earth sign ruled by Saturn, protect your boundaries and follow through. Follow for daily updates.
